plugins.name: delegation-policies
plugins.description: Delegation policies — when to delegate to a subagent, the class of each planned task (critical, standard, light, ops), and the models, reviews and reasoning effort each class gets per client

plugins.name: diagrampowers
plugins.description: Technical diagramming skills — tool selection by journey and complexity, per-format authoring (ASCII, PlantUML, D2, draw.io) that produces durable version-controlled source+SVG diagrams, and co-located per-tool installer subagents

plugins.name: gardenpowers
plugins.description: The engineering-documentation layer — gardens Superpowers working memory (specs, plans) into durable, traceable records (requirements, design, decisions, technotes) reconciled against the code, and flags drift between shipped docs and the as-built code

plugins.name: metapowers
plugins.description: The metapowers baseline — composes Superpowers (TDD/brainstorm/plan, via plugin), metapowers-core (the scope-discipline and international-english rules), and delegation-policies (the delegation rules and the delegation-routing skill)

plugins.name: metapowers-core
plugins.description: The scope-discipline and international-english rules, without Superpowers

plugins.name: upskill
plugins.description: One-shot install of the driftsys upskill discipline — meta-skills for authoring durable agent content (rules, skills, agents) under upskill management.
